_doc: Packaging allowlist. Every packaged file is one entry here; the build copies nothing that is not listed. `legacy` classifies every existing harness file so nothing is silently dropped or vendored. Kinds map to package paths: skill -> skills/<id>/SKILL.md (+ agents/openai.yaml for codex), reference -> references/, template -> templates/, schema -> schemas/, script -> scripts/, script-lib -> scripts/lib/, adapter -> scripts/adapters/<host-dir>/, hook-adapter -> scripts/adapters/<host-dir>/ (hooks.json -> hooks/hooks.json, host-specific), hook-core -> hooks/core/, contract -> contracts/, memory-template -> templates/memory/<rel>, manifest -> generated native manifest. An entry may carry an explicit package-relative `output` (never absolute, never ..) and a `host` restriction.

digest_inputs._doc: Source digest = every file under these roots plus these globs. Generated output (packages/, dist/, marketplace manifests, docs/harness/) is never an input.

entries.description: Load project context: rules, memory routing, brief, architecture, plans, repo state. Read-only.
Design before building: resolve the topic, write a Draft spec, independent cross-model review, single user approval, optional continuation to plan-feature.
Turn an approved spec into an implementation plan with EXPECT/VALIDATE tasks and explicit execution effort, grilled and independently reviewed.
Guided bootstrap of a project profile: interview, consent-gated writes, plugin capability groups, legacy-only dependency routing.
Compact the session into a project-local handoff document under .agents/handoffs/.
In-spec approval stamp: apply the declared metadata transition and verify the canonical spec bytes.
Rules authority (brownfield CLAUDE.md vs greenfield shared rules), rendering with legacy-heading compatibility, publish derivation.
Absent-only memory seeding and the readiness report used by prime/setup-start.
Opt-in backlog Status/Ref write-back for an unambiguously matched work package.
Shared dependency preflight plus delegation to the project-owned check-project-deps.sh.
Shared hook runner: host payload → normalized event → core policy → host-supported response.
Project-side wrapper commands for plugin skills (templates/wrappers/, starter .claude/commands/, sync-filter stubs).
Create a clean git commit scoped to the files this session edited; foreign changes are reported, never staged.
Push local commits to origin on the current branch with protected-branch confirmation and tag push.
Pull the latest changes on the current branch from origin with auto-stash and conflict stop.
Create a version release: CHANGELOG (if kept), manifest bump, optional doc sync, commit, annotated tag.
Prepare a pull request: push, title and destination from the Branch model and tracker, filled template, create-PR URL.
Bootstrap a tracker task: branch type from the issue, working branch off the fresh base, prime, brainstorm.
Documentation sync agent spawned by release on Claude Code (harness:documentation-manager); Codex performs the sync inline.
